sources.description: AX Check product homepage: reading rules (grade is provisional/technical-only; sessions do not contribute; unassessed is not failed), API surface list, status/error semantics.

Show HN thread, 'Ax-check.com - Can agents use your product?' (38 points, 41 comments, 2026-09-17): maker's ephemeral/simulated-account answer, install-rate-is-a-bad-metric comment, the news.ycombinator.com A-for-pricing bug report and the maker's 'Will fix this!' reply, the 'too noisy' motivation, the skeptic's no-10x datapoint, and the vendor's 500-runs / 55% documentation figures.

AXRAY homepage and AX specification 1.5.x: the 293-site baseline (median 68, mean 60, zero sites in 90-100), category medians, h1/navigation failure counts, the 292-site wider baseline, spec v1.5.1-vs-v1.5.7 caveat, five weighted pillars and the crippled-method description.

Fly.io AX Check report (checked 2026-09-17): grade A 100/100, 21 pass / 2 unassessed / 22 checks, 599,360-byte pricing fetch, no FLY_API_TOKEN, 401 from Machines API and UNAUTHORIZED from GraphQL, hallucinated .md/API URL 404s.

Supabase AX Check report, re-run 2026-10-05: grade A 100/100, all three sessions completed and reported Free/Pro $25/Team $599, onboarding login_required, five passing Activation surfaces (OpenAPI 3.0 with 115 paths, MCP endpoint, CLI via npm/Homebrew/Scoop, registry SDKs, npx skills add supabase/agent-skills), session tokens now avg 131,408 (min 21,359 / max 289,667).
Pierview.ai AX Check report (2026-09-30): grade C 63/100 and all three sessions refusing to state the published $99-$999/mo price (model conservatism).

Rankor.ai AX Check report (2026-09-30): grade F 0/100, three sessions landing on conflicting prices ($49/mo Pro, a multi-tier table, and free OSS), signup->email->login with no headless bypass, and the Cloudflare 403 browser_signature_banned event.
Bonsai.io AX Check report (2026-09-26): grade D 29/100, one session returning only a run_meta event with no trace, no anonymous cluster provisioning and interactive-only dashboard signup.
Gauge (vendor behind AX Check) marketing site, used for the vendor identity/positioning.
Gauge documentation, used for the vendor's agent-usability definition and install-rate-is-not-conversion framing.
Internal cross-link to this site's earlier llms.txt guide (GEO/AEO layer).

Legit.Show 7-Frame deterministic benchmark entry for ax-check.com (2026-09-17): 69/100 overall, the per-frame table (Reliability 100, Performance 95, Accessibility 94, Standards 92, Discoverability 57), and Privacy 0.
